note:
**The meaning of the verses**
﴿وَابْتَغِ فِيمَا آتَاكَ اللَّهُ الدَّارَ الْآخِرَةَ ۖ وَلَا تَنسَ نَصِيبَكَ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا ۖ وَأَحْسِن كَمَا أَحْسَنَ اللَّهُ إِلَيْكَ ۖ وَلَا تَبْغِ الْفَسَادَ فِي الْأَرْضِ ۖ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ الْمُفْسِدِينَ﴾
And seek, through the wealth Allah has given you, the reward of the Home of the Hereafter, by using it in obedience to Allah in this world. And do not give up your share of this world, by enjoying what is lawful in it without extravagance. And be good to people with charity, as Allah has been good to you with this great wealth. And do not seek what Allah has forbidden you of corruption in the land and oppression of your people. Allah does not love those who cause corruption, and He will repay them for their evil deeds.

﴿وَقَالَ الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْعِلْمَ وَيْلَكُمْ ثَوَابُ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ لِّمَنْ آمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا وَلَا يُلَقَّاهَا إِلَّا الصَّابِرُونَ﴾
And those who were given knowledge of Allah and His law, and who knew the reality of things, said to those who had said, "If only we had the like of what Qarun has been given": "Woe to you! Fear Allah and obey Him. Allah's reward for whoever believes in Him and His messengers and does righteous deeds is better than what Qarun has been given." And no one accepts this advice, is guided to it and acts on it except one who struggles against himself, is patient in obeying his Lord, and avoids disobeying Him.

﴿تِلْكَ الدَّارُ الْآخِرَةُ نَجْعَلُهَا لِلَّذِينَ لَا يُرِيدُونَ عُلُوًّا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فَسَادًا ۚ وَالْعَاقِبَةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ﴾
That Home of the Hereafter: We make its bliss for those who do not want arrogance against the truth in the land, nor corruption in it. And the praiseworthy outcome — which is Paradise — is for whoever guards himself against Allah's punishment, does acts of obedience and leaves what is forbidden.

📖 At-Tafsir Al-Muyassar — King Fahd Complex.

**Talk with your child**
1. What did the good people say to Qarun? Did they ask him to give up his wealth? (No: ﴿وَلَا تَنسَ نَصِيبَكَ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا﴾ (and do not forget your share of this world). Enjoying what is lawful is allowed; what is forbidden is arrogant, boastful joy, forgetting the One who gave, and holding back from those in need.)
2. Qarun said: ﴿إِنَّمَا أُوتِيتُهُ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عِندِي﴾ (I was only given it because of knowledge I have). What is wrong with what he said? And who gave him the wealth?
3. Some people wished they were in Qarun's place, and the people of knowledge did not wish it. What did those who had wished it say after the earth swallowed him? And why were the people of knowledge not fooled by the glitter?

**This week's exercise**
Every evening this week your child mentions one blessing they have — food, a toy, good health or a friend — and says, "Alhamdulillah, Who gave it to me." And once during the week, they give someone else something they love, as Qarun was told: ﴿وَأَحْسِن كَمَا أَحْسَنَ اللَّهُ إِلَيْكَ﴾ (and do good as Allah has done good to you).
